limitations: Six seen-condition calibration cases are separate from two fresh validation conditions and ten new test pairs.
Both cases in a candidate group must jointly pass; feasible groups rank only by mean original physical duration, then declared order.
A numerically valid baseline task failure remains a negative comparator; it cannot become an elite or be relabelled as a task success.
Validation may gate release; it may not retune the candidate or select a baseline fallback.
Only coarse dose speed changes; both roles retain first87/retry87.2 and all other actions/physics.
Prepare-prefix equivalence stops before the coarse speed intervention; changed post-coarse outcomes are retained.
Invalid/partial attempts retain their actual last-available measurement basis and do not become valid terminal measurements.
This finite calibration is not CEM, PPO or a fitted neural policy; collector-only no-fit metadata does not erase calibration selection.
The prior spill classification time preceded the first-angle action but does not establish emission cause or guarantee a speed remedy.
Fixed40mL and narrow randomization do not establish arbitrary target or hardware precision.
Kinematic pregrasp and privileged particle truth are not contact-grasp or real-scale validation.
